TGO.note: Document states nothing on AI harm rules or an authority.
Document describes a data-collection challenge, not an AI system in use in administration.
Applications in health, administration and justice are future possibilities only; no sectoral AI tool is piloted or in service.
Document refers to a national AI strategy with local-language data among its priorities and a 2030 West African AI hub aim, but does not say it was approved or validated by the government.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation launched on 5 October 2026 a national local-languages challenge, first stage of the three-year Voix du Togo programme, collecting voice and text data (50 validated audio hours, 6,000 translated sentence pairs, 500 speakers per language) to train AI models, with a one-month pilot on Ewe, Kabye and Moba.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation

TGO.note: Document states nothing on startup law, labelling or funds; startups are only named as future competition participants.
Document names no hub, incubator or technology park.
